Both requests are registered; handlers require the active character's actor.
Unhang reads the current sticky target server-side; both broadcasts exclude
the sender. These handlers do not establish the native admission contract or
guarantee an own-client confirmation. Lane reason u32 retains the same bits.

Root prerequisite for any future Session adapter: active captured character and
own-actor identity; source-backed live candidate/eligibility/cooldown; character
and target lifecycle generation; Unhang expected-target fence rechecked before
write so a stale action cannot unhang a replacement target. No target guard is
serialized and packet construction alone establishes none of these conditions.
